source_text: De eo quod scriptum est: munera mea data mea. Observatio sacrificiorum typica si permaneret, evangelii fidem excluderet.
pass_a_gloss: Concerning that which written-is: gifts my given my. Observance of-sacrifices typical if it-would-remain, of-gospel faith would-exclude.
pass_b_english: On the word [[My gifts, my presents >> Bible:Numbers 28:2]]: if the typical sacrificial observance still stood, it would shut out gospel faith.
